info.name: AppConnect V3 Account Services Contacts Reporting API

params.name: contact_id
params.description: The contact's ID for which tracking activity data is requested.

params.name: tracking_activities_list
params.description: Specify one or more tracking activity types to include as a comma-delimited string. The `tracking_activities_list`  and `tracking_activities_type` query parameters are mutually exclusive.

params.name: tracking_activity_type
params.description: Specify one or more tracking activity types to include as an array. The `tracking_activities_list`  and `tracking_activities_type` query parameters are mutually exclusive.

params.name: include_campaign_activity_names
params.description: Default (`true`) returns campaign activity names in the results. Not including campaign activity names in the results (`false`), is more efficient.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of tracking activities to return in a single page. Valid values are 1 to 100. Default is 100.

items.docs:
Gets the tracking activity data for a single contact, sorted in descending activity date order.

You must chose either the `tracking_activities_list` query parameter and or the `tracking_activity_type` query parameter to specify one or more tracking activity types In the request. The `tracking_activities_list` and `tracking_activities_type` query parameters are mutually exclusive.

Valid tracking activity types

info.name: GET Average Open and Click Rates

params.name: contact_id
params.description: The contact id which is requesting tracking activity data (e.g. aa9ff7b0-478d-11e6-8059-00163e3c8e19)

params.name: start
params.description: The starting date, in ISO 8601 format, to use to get campaigns. For example: 2019-01-01T00:00:00-0500.

params.name: end
params.description: The ending date, in ISO 8601 format, to use to get campaigns. For example: 2019-12-01T00:00:00-0500.

items.docs:
Gets the average open and click rate for a given account and contact.

Looks at all tracking activities for bulk emails from a given contact over the given date range. Range cannot exceed 5 years.

Returns the rates and the number of campaign activities that were included in the calculation.

If no activities fall into the given date range, all rates will return 0 and the number of included activities will be 0.

params.name: end

items.docs: Get a list of the recent emails (aka, campaign activities) sent to a specific contact and a summary of the actions the contact took on that email for the most recent 200 campaigns.
